description: This file defines various BufferList-based buffer generators for PostgreSQL protocol messages used in testing environments.

methods.name: readyForQuery
methods.description: Constructs a BufferList for the 'Ready For Query' PostgreSQL message.

methods.name: authenticationOk
methods.description: Constructs a BufferList indicating successful authentication.

methods.name: authenticationCleartextPassword
methods.description: Constructs a BufferList for cleartext password authentication message.

methods.name: authenticationMD5Password
methods.description: Constructs a BufferList for MD5 password authentication message.

methods.name: authenticationSASL
methods.description: Constructs a BufferList for SASL authentication method message.

methods.name: authenticationSASLContinue
methods.description: Constructs a BufferList for SASL authentication continuation message.

methods.name: authenticationSASLFinal
methods.description: Constructs a BufferList for SASL authentication final message.

methods.name: parameterStatus
methods.description: Builds a BufferList for a parameter status update.

methods.name: backendKeyData
methods.description: Creates a BufferList containing backend process ID and secret key data.

methods.name: commandComplete
methods.description: Builds a BufferList for command completion message.

methods.name: rowDescription
methods.description: Creates a BufferList describing row fields for query results.

methods.name: parameterDescription
methods.description: Builds a BufferList describing data types of fields.

methods.name: dataRow
methods.description: Creates a BufferList representing a row of data columns.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Builds a BufferList for an error message.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Builds a BufferList for a notice message.

methods.name: errorOrNotice
methods.description: Builds a BufferList for error or notice fields.

methods.name: parseComplete
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating parse completion.

methods.name: bindComplete
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating bind completion.

methods.name: notification
methods.description: Constructs a BufferList for a notification message.

methods.name: emptyQuery
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating an empty query.

methods.name: portalSuspended
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating portal suspension.

methods.name: closeComplete
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating close command completion.

methods.name: copyIn
methods.description: Builds a BufferList for COPY IN command.

methods.name: copyOut
methods.description: Builds a BufferList for COPY OUT command.

methods.name: copyData
methods.description: Creates a BufferList containing raw bytes data for copy operations.

methods.name: copyDone
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating copy operation is done.
